ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar provides the MFA design student with tools to define and develop their body of work within a specific and individually created path. Course outcomes include: a more defined area of inquiry, an understanding of the context of their work, and paramenters for further self-initiated work. This seminar will facilitate a sharing of student work and research in order to collectively strategize methods to push the trajectory of each forward. Weekly readings and written critiques of literature is expected. Graduate Section.
